crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
“Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.
Don’t be furious, Yahweh. Don’t remember iniquity forever. Look and see, we beg you, we are all your people.
Have you utterly rejected Judah? Has your soul loathed Zion? Why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We…

translations.web: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?
translations.bsb: Why have You forgotten us forever? Why have You forsaken us for so long?
translations.kjv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?
translations.asv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, And forsake us so long time?
